name: Denethor
subtitle: Lord of Minas Tirith
game_text:
To play, spot 2 <culture>Gondor</culture> Men.
<phase>Fellowship</phase>: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a <culture>Gondor</culture> card into hand from your draw deck, then reshuffle. Choose an opponent who may draw 2 cards.
flavor_text: “There Denethor sat in a grey gloom, like an old patient spider....”
